_comment: March to contact stance: a plain move order that stops to fight anything it meets along the way, then resumes toward its original destination once the fight ends -- unlike NORMAL's push-through default. A lone player Infantry (team 0, 50 soldiers) at (500,300) is ordered under March to contact to (500,650); a weak enemy Infantry (team 1, 12 soldiers, Hold-ordered so it never advances on its own) sits directly in the path at (500,430). all_teams_control lets the script Hold the hostile in place first, isolating the player unit's own stance behavior from any enemy-side decision-making. drill is set purely so Battle._check_victory's normal auto-end-on-last-enemy-gone doesn't pause the sim once the weak hostile is fully beaten -- there IS real combat here, this is not a no-opponent rehearsal. The player unit holds until the March-to-contact order lands (the no-order default), so contact is later than a clip that leaned on auto-advance: it is still MOVING at tick 200, FIGHTING by tick 250 through 330, then resumes and is MOVING again by tick 600, arriving near (500,650) with the original MOVE order still on the queue. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd. World coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
